Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly inferred that the director of the 2011 film "Ready" (Anees Bazmee) is from Indonesia. The Wikipedia page retrieved by the WebSurfer clearly stated the film is an "Indian Hindi-language action comedy film," and Anees Bazmee is a well-known Indian filmmaker. The Planner failed to extract the correct nationality (India) from the available text and hallucinated the country as Indonesia, leading to the wrong conclusion that the directors are from different countries.
